items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: With this same band, Andre Rialte, and Guy Leon was playing the trumpet, and we had a wonderful time.

ctx.x: But all the records I did over there, and when I got paid, I just sent it to Belgium because I was going there anyway, so I did that. And when we got to Belgium, we stayed there 10 weeks. It was nice, beautiful. With this same band, Andre Rialte, and Guy Leon was playing the trumpet, and we had a wonderful time. And I met King Farouk there and we had a big argument with him about the -- he wanted me to have champagne. The waiter came and said, 'The King would like for you to have a drink.' And I didn't even know…

he brought me a thing of beer, you know, and then the next day he called me at the hotel about 10:00 o'clock in the morning. Another run-in. I said, "Who is this?" I don't get up till about 1:00, you know. So he said, "This is Farouk." I said, "What do you want, man, at this time of the morning?" He said, "I've got a cabana down here," on the thing. Wanted me to come down and get some sun and everything. I said, "I'll be down about 2:00 o'clock." He said, "No, come down now." I said, "No, uh-uh. I can't come down…
